name: Spitfire Tacos - La Jolla
notes: All 5 photos are menus. Photos 1-2 are the same digital burrito-bowl/totchos/sides/chuffles board, merged; photo 3 is a clearer close-up of the tacos & burritos board also seen partially in photo 1 (used photo 3's prices as more legible). Photo 4 is a separate 'Firebird by Spitfire' breakfast-burrito sandwich-board at the same location, added as its own sections. Photo 5 is a printed tri-fold menu with a different taco/burrito lineup and pricing than the digital board; overlapping items (Al Pastor, Pollo Asado, Jermell's Jerk Chicken, Korean BBQ Pork Belly, Carnitas, Carne Asada Street, Aloha 808) were treated as duplicates and kept once (board version), while items unique to the tri-fold were added with a qualifier to avoid name collisions with same-named items in other sections. Chips add-on modifiers to other dishes were skipped; standalone chips sides were kept.
